keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across document titles and text (e.g. "data privacy", "emissions standards"). Leave blank to skip.

agencySlug.title: Agency
agencySlug.description: Limit to one agency, using its Federal Register slug (e.g. "environmental-protection-agency", "securities-and-exchange-commission", "food-and-drug-administration"). Find the exact slug in the agency's federalregister.gov URL. Leave blank for all agencies.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: RULE = final rule (already in effect or scheduled), PRORULE = proposed rule (open for public comment), NOTICE = agency notice, PRESDOCU = presidential document.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by publication date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of documents to return, most recently published first.
